## Setup

### Packages

```{r}
install.packages("tidyverse")
```


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```



```{r}
penguins <- read_csv(file="data/penguin_dataset.csv")
```


```{r}
penguins |>
    na.omit() |>
    arrange(bill_len) |>
    head()
```

```{r}
penguins  |>  count(island)
```


```{r}
ggplot(data = penguins,
       mapping = aes(x = bill_len,
                     y = bill_dep,
                     colour = species)) +
    geom_point()
```
